title: Agent Controlled Remote Host Runner and Tool Suite
status_reason: Moved to its own project, Cybri, on hv's word of 2026-11-27 (vc decision 350). The handover is with that project's mediator. devbin keeps no part of the work.
objective: Find out, by a spike, whether one coding agent can direct many runs on remote hosts through a daemon that does the work without inference and returns curated results. Decide the design, the project it lives in and its name. This thread is not part of a devbin release.
context: hv set this thread on 2026-11-27, in the mediator's window (vc decision 349). The brief: a daemon in Rust, one for each host, that an LLM elsewhere on the network directs. It runs a hierarchy of managers and workers under given privileges and injected secrets, keeps semantic logs, and applies the log filters that the LLM sets. The aim is fewer coding agent sessions, each directing many runners. hv expects the work to move to its own project. The mediator holds hv's brief and the spike note outside this tree until hv decides where they live.
